artifact_observations.reasoning: The cross-hatched/grid texture on the lower half appears slightly 'muddy' and inconsistent. The lines do not maintain perfect geometric regularity expected of machined metal, showing slight waviness and blending into the base material, suggestive of AI texture generation rather than physical engraving.

The edge of the lid and the top right corner of the body lack sharp definition. There is a slight softness or 'melting' where the lid meets the body, and the rectangular geometry feels slightly warped rather than perfectly rigid.
The serrations on the flint wheel are indistinct and blurry. While this could be depth-of-field, in AI generations, fine mechanical details like gear teeth often fail to resolve sharply.
